IF SQLCODE = 100 MOVE 'N' TO INQCUST-INQ-SUCCESS MOVE '9' TO INQCUST-INQ-FAIL-CD GO TO GLCDE999 END-IF
*>EXECCICS EXEC CICS FORMATTIME *>EXECCICS ABSTIME(WS-U-TIME) *>EXECCICS DDMMYYYY(WS-ORIG-DATE) *>EXECCICS TIME(WS-TIME-NOW) *>EXECCICS DATESEP *>EXECCICS END-EXEC }
